summary: Flathead National Forest lookout site in Powell County, Montana, about 21 miles northeast of Seeley Lake; dated only to the 1930s, history unknown, now gone.

facts.status_note: Gone. The sources give no history beyond a 1930s date.

evidence.supports: about 21 miles northeast of Seeley Lake
Flathead National Forest, Powell County, Montana
dated only to the 1930s; history unknown; gone

notes_for_editor: Thinnest record of the three. The only history is firelookout.com's '1930s: history unknown', so no events are listed because no year is given. The Forest Lookouts page gives only the county, forest and survey location. The FFLA coordinates match the record's point. Nothing read gives the builder, design, staffing, fires or present-day condition. Two web searches turned up only the same pages and unrelated Seeley Lake material. The Seeley Lake Pathfinder article on lookouts that I checked does not mention this site. An editor could check Flathead National Forest records before publishing. No photos added.
